subject: Clearline: request to pause scheduled purge and provide backup manifest for audit
messages:
From: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@clearline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-team@clearline.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: URGENT: Please pause purge for project CLEAR-21 (audit hold)

Hi Kimberly,

We're starting a surprise regulatory readiness audit for our CLEAR-21 pilot. The auditors notified us this morning and requested that we preserve all production data and logs for the last 90 days for the dataset referenced in SOW CLEAR-21 (tenant id: clear-21-prod).

Our current DPA retention schedule lists a 30-day log retention and 14-day snapshot purge. We need Redwood to:

- Pause any scheduled deletion/purge for snapshots and logs tied to clear-21-prod immediately
- Provide a manifest of retained snapshots and their IDs, plus the last 90 days of logging indices you currently hold
- Confirm whether any subprocessors in APAC or third-party logging vendors have access to the tenant data
- Provide an expected window when normal purge operations will resume or provide guidance to request a formal extension via DPA amendment

We attached the audit notice (clearline_audit_notice.pdf). We need confirmation by EOD today (May 10) that you have placed a temporary hold and will produce the manifest within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Claire Simmons
DPO, Clearline Therapeutics
claire.simmons@clearline.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment: clearline_audit_notice.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@clearline.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: URGENT: Please pause purge for project CLEAR-21 (audit hold)

Claire — thanks for the heads up and the audit notice. I've triaged this and looped in Ops (Priyom) and Legal (Karthik). High-level next steps from Redwood:

1) We can place an emergency retention hold immediately to prevent scheduled purges.
2) Ops will produce a manifest of snapshots and logging indices within 48 hours.
3) Legal will advise on the DPA amendment language required for retention beyond the contractual baseline.

A few quick clarifying items so we scope the hold correctly:
- Confirm whether the auditors need raw snapshots (S3/GCS ids) and/or exported log bundles.
- Are there particular date windows (e.g., 2028-02-01 to 2028-05-10) you want preserved, or do you want the full 90-day set?

I've attached a small manifest template (proposed_hold_manifest_template.csv) that Ops can populate; please review and confirm the fields you need (snapshot_id, creation_ts, location, retention_tag).

I'll follow up once Ops has the initial manifest.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: proposed_hold_manifest_template.csv (csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@clearline.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 08:40:00 -0400
Subject: RE: URGENT: Please pause purge for project CLEAR-21 (audit hold)

Kimberly / Claire — Ops update and concrete actions.

Summary of current state:
- Clear-21 tenant has daily snapshots stored in GCP (bucket: redwood-clearline-prod) with a 14-day automatic lifecycle that will run during the next maintenance window on 2028-05-12 02:00 UTC.
- Application logs are forwarded to LogFlow (third-party logging provider) with indices retained for 30 days by default; we have on-disk archives for 90 days available via restore but those are subject to a separate purge schedule.

What we can do immediately:
- We have created an emergency hold token and applied it to the clear-21-prod retention group; this will suspend lifecycle deletion and skip the purge in the 2028-05-12 window.
- Ops will produce a manifest of all snapshot IDs and last-modified timestamps and a list of LogFlow index names by EOD 2028-05-11. See snapshot_ids.txt for the first-pass list (attached).

Operational constraints and recommended timeline:
- We can maintain this hold for an initial 21 days with minimal operational risk. Extending beyond 21 days requires an approved DPA addendum and a scheduled storage cost pass-through.
- If the auditors need exported bundles, we can generate a sanitized export (S3 URL) within 48 hours; that will require a secure transfer approval and a ticket to Security for temporary access tokens.

Subprocessor/access note:
- Subprocessors with potential access: GCP (storage), LogFlow (logs), and a managed backup operator (VaultOps). We have verified they do not perform arbitrary reprocessing; access is limited to mechanical storage and restore operations.

Next steps requested from Clearline:
- Confirm you want the full 90-day set or a narrower window.
- Confirm export preference (raw snapshots vs. exported log bundle).

Attachment: snapshot_ids.txt (text)

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@clearline.com>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: RE: URGENT: Please pause purge for project CLEAR-21 (audit hold)

Team / Claire — Legal note on DPA implications and subprocessors.

Short answer: we can support a temporary audit hold operationally, but retention beyond what our DPA permits requires an addendum that:

- Explicitly authorizes an "audit hold" for the tenant and scope (snapshots/log indices), including start/end dates or rolling extension terms.
- Requires the customer to acknowledge additional storage costs for the extension beyond contracted thresholds and authorizes specific subprocessor obligations (GCP, LogFlow, VaultOps) to retain data as necessary for the hold.
- Clarifies cross-border transfer safeguards — if we must export logs from EU to US for analysis we need SCCs or a lawful basis recorded; if Clearline is EU-based or has EU subjects, we need to capture that now.

I've prepared a DPA addendum template with the minimum language we need (dpa_addendum_redwood_v1.docx). Claire, if you can sign the DocuSign link I've included (https://docusign.com/CL-DS-99827) we can authorize the extended retention and Ops can confirm a more durable timeline.

Caveat: We must limit any retained data to the scope requested by auditors and not create indefinite retention without a documented lawful basis.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: dpa_addendum_redwood_v1.docx (docx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@clearline.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: RE: URGENT: Please pause purge for project CLEAR-21 (audit hold) — HOLD PLACED

Claire — confirming the following as of 11:00 AM ET on 2028-05-14:

- A temporary hold is in place for clear-21-prod that prevents the scheduled 2028-05-12 purge and any automatic lifecycle deletions.
- Ops exported an initial manifest and snapshot id list; attached is the operational manifest with snapshot_id, creation_ts, bucket, and retention_tag (hold_manifest_confirmed.csv).
- LogFlow indices for the requested 90-day window are flagged and a restore/export can be produced; we can provide an S3 export on a secure link within 36 hours if you confirm.

Please sign the DPA addendum via DocuSign (https://docusign.com/CL-DS-99827) so we can extend the hold beyond the initial 21-day safe window and approve the cost pass-through. Once signed:
- Ops will convert the temporary hold into a DPA-backed retention exception and schedule checkpoint snapshots for long-term preservation.

If you want the export now, reply with preferred delivery (encrypted S3 presigned URL or SFTP) and a contact who will receive the artifact.

Thanks — we can keep this thread for operational updates, or I can open OPS-6123 for runbook tracking.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: hold_manifest_confirmed.csv (csv)
